in_marathi.name: Avalika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avalika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'avalambana' which means 'support' or 'sustenance'. The name Avalika is believed to represent the joy and happiness a mother feels when she holds her newborn child. This name is rich in cultural significance and is often given to baby girls in Hindu communities.
